{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers
n_loyal = len(loyal_customers)

# Compute the number of converted loyal customers
converted_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print each number exactly as it will appear in evidence
print(f"n_loyal = {n_loyal}")
print(f"converted_loyal = {converted_loyal}")
print(f"fraction_converted = {fraction_converted}")

# Also print the rounded value for the answer, but only as a guide
print(f"answer_value = {fraction_converted:.3f}")"}
